ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the ventral surface, occupying approximately 90% of the visible area, with a sharp transition to low-intensity (black) pixels at the trailing edge and lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a continuous high-intensity white field. A continuous, thin black border (approx. 10-20 pixel width) tracks the entire trailing edge from the left tip through the median notch to the right tip. High-density black mottled dendritic patterns are localized at the far lateral-superior tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. The left lobe trailing edge displays irregular, higher-amplitude peaks and valleys with a significant indentation roughly one-third of the distance from the tip to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch extending to acute, sharply tapered tips on both lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 14 discrete, circular and elliptical low-intensity grey/black clusters (ranging 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the mid-ventral white field, representing localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple circular impact/attachment scars scattered across the central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black vein-like filigree patterns concentrated at the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke tips.
